context.transcript:
Hi Paul.
We need to discuss the budget before we presented it tomorrow's meeting with the company president.
Look what percentage of our expenses go to rent.
I think we should suggest downsizing.
I looked online at some office spaces and we could easily cut our rent expenses by 5%.
That's a good point.
Plus many employees have started to work remotely from their homes so we really don't need an office this size anymore.
I'm glad that you agree.
Why don't we adjust the presentation for tomorrow's meeting to include more information about this idea.
Sounds good.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，保罗。
我们需要讨论一下预算，因为明天要向公司总裁展示它。
看看我们的开支中有多少百分比用于租金。
我想我们应该建议缩小规模。
我在网上看了些办公空间，我们可以轻松地把租金支出减少5%。
这是个好观点。
而且很多员工已经开始在家远程工作了，所以我们真的不需要这么大的办公室了。
我很高兴你同意。
为什么不调整一下明天会议的演示文稿，加入更多关于这个想法的信息呢？
听起来不错。
